claim: Rank-one H3 DAS optimized against the worst of four task/panel environments using behavior, L15 H5/H1, and full-vocabulary readers, with antithetic tangent noise and sealed odd-row/v8/v9 evaluation.
novelty: Prior DAS fits used one scalar/full-vocabulary objective or optimized rank-seven compression. This fit shares each intervention across three causally distinct readers, minimizes a smooth worst-environment objective, and never selects on v8/v9.

opposing_predictions.robust_operator: Held-out objective improves over the pooled-aligned seed and sealed v8/v9 mean and worst scores improve over the frozen pooled-aligned axis.
opposing_predictions.task_memorization: Training improves but held-out or sealed multi-reader scores do not improve.
opposing_predictions.objective_miss: The optimizer cannot improve held-out loss from the pooled-aligned seed, or improvements trade off independent reader families.

frozen_design.selection: lowest actual worst-environment loss on held-out odd rows over frozen ten-step checkpoints

null: Any trained-only gain without odd-row and sealed-reader improvement is recorded as task memorization, not a better circuit.
